name: chatbot
description: Monorepo root — orchestration only. Each app under apps/* is self-contained (own deps, build, Dockerfile). Shared code lives in packages/*.

scripts.build:all: npm run build:web && npm run build:engine && npm run build:connectors
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:web && npm run build:engine && npm run build:connectors && node scripts/build/prepare-out.mjs
scripts.build:connectors: npm run build:mssql && npm run build:oracle && npm run build:csv
scripts.test: cd apps/web && npm test && cd ../engine && npm test
scripts.lint:all: cd apps/web && npm run lint && cd ../engine && npm run lint
scripts.lint:fix:all: cd apps/web && npm run lint:fix && cd ../engine && npm run lint:fix
scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env.dev -- concurrently --restart-tries 3 --restart-after 2000 -n engine,ui -c blue,green "cd apps/engine && npm run dev" "cd apps/web && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:mock: dotenv -e .env.mock -- concurrently --restart-tries 3 --restart-after 2000 -n mock,engine,ui -c yellow,blue,green "npm run svc:mock-api" "cd apps/engine && npm run dev" "cd apps/web && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:mssql: dotenv -e .env.dev -- concurrently --restart-tries 3 --restart-after 2000 -n engine,mssql,ui -c blue,cyan,green "cd apps/engine && npm run dev" "cd apps/mssql-connector && npm run dev" "cd apps/web && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:oracle: dotenv -e .env.dev -- concurrently --restart-tries 3 --restart-after 2000 -n engine,oracle,ui -c blue,magenta,green "cd apps/engine && npm run dev" "cd apps/oracle-connector && npm run dev" "cd apps/web && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:csv: dotenv -e .env.dev -- concurrently --restart-tries 3 --restart-after 2000 -n engine,csv,ui -c blue,red,green "cd apps/engine && npm run dev" "cd apps/csv-xlsx-connector && npm run dev" "cd apps/web && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:all: dotenv -e .env.dev -- concurrently --restart-tries 3 --restart-after 2000 -n mock,engine,mssql,oracle,csv,ui -c yellow,blue,cyan,magenta,red,green "npm run svc:mock-api" "cd apps/engine && npm run dev" "cd apps/mssql-connector && npm run dev" "cd apps/oracle-connector && npm run dev" "cd apps/csv-xlsx-connector && npm run dev" "cd apps/web && npm run dev"
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n mock,engine,ui -c yellow,blue,green "npm run svc:mock-api" "cd apps/engine && npm start" "cd apps/web && npm start"
scripts.start:demo: dotenv -e .env.demo -- concurrently -n mock,engine,ui -c yellow,blue,green "npm run svc:mock-api" "cd apps/engine && npm start" "cd apps/web && npm start"
scripts.start:uat: dotenv -e .env.uat -- concurrently -n engine,ui -c blue,green "cd apps/engine && npm start" "cd apps/web && npm start"
scripts.start:prod: dotenv -e .env.prod -- concurrently -n engine,ui -c blue,green "cd apps/engine && npm start" "cd apps/web && npm start"
